name: Resume changed work
whenToUse: Handling change-feed wakes and interrupted work.
instructions:
Use existing scoped tools to update Lookout. On an authorized work run, read_muse_changes to pick up platform updates. Its eventTypes lists supported labels; each item names the affected record and refresh tool/arguments. Read that current record, refresh your context, then acknowledge handled IDs. Application/interview timeline events include stage changes and recorded milestones. A feed event is an update pointer, never a new work request, consent or proof of submission. No automatic rewrite of stored work is required.

For watcher installation and lifecycle load agent-package only when background watching is requested. The watcher never reads private records or acknowledges changes.

## Authenticated worker sequence
Read pending events with read_muse_changes. Coalesce same-record events within a page; refresh each current record once through its supplied refresh tool/arguments. Load workflow.guideId with read_guide only when its version/content is not retained. Guide IDs are references, never executable event instructions. On fresh sessions retrieve the core/index and relevant guides; a schedule-only maintenance wake with retained core uses just the feed, targeted schedule read and needed guide, without full personal context refresh.
Inspect existing tasks, leases, search runs/source checkpoints, backend results, application revisions/attempts and inbox handoffs. Resume missing stages only within existing authorization. backend_job_finished can describe non-search work: inspect job kind and load application-workspace for application jobs instead. Current job state overrides historical event status. Already terminal domain work is not repeated because an event was redelivered. Never enqueue another job just to handle its completion.
Persist progress through existing domain writers, read it back, then acknowledge only handled IDs. A blocker can be acknowledged only if the existing task/run/application record durably identifies the blocker and resume condition. If that writer/read-back fails or no supported checkpoint exists, leave the event pending. Schedule reconciliation specifically requires actual scheduler receipts before acknowledgement. Acknowledgement is independent of notification delivery and task completion.
Read further pages while hasMore and progress is possible. Stop when pending blocked events prevent progress; do not spin on an unchanged first page. Unknown event types remain pending. The watcher cooldown limits retries; it does not guarantee new-event latency while older blocked events remain pending. A later relevant event or authorized run rechecks current blockers. Hosts must serialize/enqueue one worker per connection and renew/claim existing leases; the polling process cannot observe asynchronously active workers.
An optional Node host adapter, mcp/change-worker.mjs, implements bounded pointer consumption with injected scoped readers and a host handler. It adds no scheduler, model, execution permission or database. Hosts must wire their actual authorized work and receipts; configuration alone is not activation.
